{{Quote|I have the serum. We must leave quickly, friend.|Boba Fett, to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="Faith" />}}
A '''serum''' existed for a [[sleeping virus]] created by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was dispensed through a [[Color/Legends|pink]] needle and was available for purchase in [[Panna City]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Panna Prime]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] was aware of the virus and where to locate it. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="Faith" /> between [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]] and [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' places the [[Mission to Panna Prime|mission]] to [[Panna Prime]] after the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], which it also placed six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], corresponding to [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. {{SW|url=news/the-best-holidays-and-celebrations-in-the-galaxy-everybodys-invited-of-course|text=The Best Holidays and Celebrations in the Galaxy&hellip;and Empire Day, Too|int=The Best Holidays and Celebrations in the Galaxy&hellip;and Empire Day, Too|nolive=1}} mentions that ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' was one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the Battle of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin]], corresponding to [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of the mission as portrayed in ''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]'' must have occurred between 0.5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and 1 ABY.</ref> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] heroes [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were infected by the virus in an [[Mission to Panna Prime|Imperial plot]], having to be suspended upside-down inside the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], Solo's [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]], to stay alive. Fett, who had been posing as an ally to discover the location of the Rebel [[Ring Base|base]] for the Empire, offered to retrieve the serum from Panna [[City/Legends|City]]. Fett quickly found the serum but did not purchase it immediately, instead making contact with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to report his progress. Fett administered the serum to Solo and Skywalker, who were initially groggy from their rescucitation, while the bounty hunter's true plan was exposed by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The serum first appeared in ''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]''.<ref name="Faith" />
